clusters.name: Bea's birth, 1995–1996
clusters.reason: Around Bea's birth in March 1995, within the following year: your mother worn out and on edge with the baby by August, she and your father in distance by November, you with stomach aches and missing school by February 1996, your brother Jonah in shouting matches with your father by May, and your mother's functioning down as she did not return to work by September. The shifts pile up across the household in these months, each person's reaction following close on the last.
